subject: linking covariates to posterior samples from an INLA object

messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: linking covariates to posterior samples from an INLA object
parts:
Dear all,

I'm trying to combine the covariates, response variable, fitted values and posterior samples when I only have the INLA object. The INLA object is based on a inla.stack which combines two stacks. The model has a single spde component called "xy_count".
Can someone confirm that the code below matches the different components correctly?

model$.args$data[c("location", "sublocation", "cwinter")] |>
  as.data.frame() -> reconstruction
reconstruction <- reconstruction[is.na(model$.args$data$xy_count), ]
reconstruction$response <- model$.args$data$count

fitted <- model$summary.fitted.values
reconstruction$fitted <- fitted[grepl("APred", rownames(fitted)), "mean"]

postsamp <- inla.posterior.sample(n = 1, result = model)
latent <- postsamp[[1]]$latent
reconstruction$postsamp <- latent[grepl("APred", rownames(latent)), ]

Best regards,

ir. Thierry Onkelinx
